question: On Republic Day 2023, which country’s contingent marched alongside the Indian troops?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Egypt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On Republic Day 2023, Egypt's Armed Forces contingent marched alongside Indian troops as part of the celebrations.
 
• This marked the first time Egypt participated in India's Republic Day parade with a military contingent.
 
• Egyptian President **Abdel Fattah El-Sisi** was the Chief Guest at India's 74th Republic Day celebrations in 2023.
 
• The Egyptian contingent consisted of 144 personnel and symbolized the growing defense ties between India and Egypt.
 
• The participation highlighted the strategic partnership and historical ties between the two nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Egypt Defense Relations**

 
 
• India and Egypt have strengthened their defense cooperation through joint military exercises and exchanges.
 
• The countries signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on defense cooperation during President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi's visit.
 
• Egypt is seen as a key strategic partner in the Middle East and Africa for India.
 
 
 
• **Republic Day Parade Significance**
 
 
• The Republic Day parade showcases India’s military strength, cultural diversity, and achievements.
 
• It is held annually on January 26th at Rajpath (renamed Kartavya Path) in New Delhi.
 
• The event commemorates the day India’s Constitution came into effect in 1950.
 
 
 
• **Chief Guest Tradition**
 
 
• Inviting a Chief Guest is a tradition to enhance diplomatic ties and signify India's global outreach.
 
• Prominent world leaders have been invited as Chief Guests over the years, including heads of state and government.
 
 
 
• **India-Egypt Historical Ties**
 
 
• India and Egypt share a long-standing friendship dating back to the Non-Aligned Movement era.
 
• Both countries have collaborated in areas like trade, education, and culture, apart from defense.
 
• Egypt was one of the first Arab countries to recognize India's independence in 1947.
